title: WUSCHEL controls genotype-dependent shoot regeneration capacity in potato.
authors: Park, Ji-Sun; Park, Kwang Hyun; Park, Su-Jin; Ko, Seo-Rin; Moon, Ki-Beom; Koo, Hyunjin; Cho, Hye Sun; Park, Sang Un; Jeon, Jae-Heung; Kim, Hyun-Soon; Lee, Hyo-Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究马铃薯中转录因子WUS调控基因型依赖的芽再生能力，涉及TF表达与细胞命运转变，但核心是植物再生生理而非TF-DNA结合机制，仅含简单的受体-配体对接计算，缺乏AI/物理模拟深度建模。
abstract: Plant cells can reprogram their fate. The combinatorial actions of auxin and cytokinin dedifferentiate somatic cells to regenerate organs, which can develop into individual plants. As transgenic plants can be generated from genetically modified somatic cells through these processes, cell fate transition is an unavoidable step in crop genetic engineering. However, regeneration capacity closely depends on the genotype, and the molecular events underlying these variances remain elusive. In the present study, we demonstrated that WUSCHEL (WUS)-a homeodomain transcription factor-determines regeneration capacity in different potato (Solanum tuberosum) genotypes. Comparative analysis of shoot regeneration efficiency and expression of genes related to cell fate transition revealed that WUS expression coincided with regeneration rate in different potato genotypes. Moreover, in a high-efficiency genotype, WUS silencing suppressed shoot regeneration. Meanwhile, in a low-efficiency genotype, regeneration could be enhanced through the supplementation of a different type of cytokinin that promoted WUS expression. Computational modeling of cytokinin receptor-ligand interactions suggested that the docking pose of cytokinins mediated by hydrogen bonding with the core residues may be pivotal for WUS expression and shoot regeneration in potatoes. Furthermore, our whole-genome sequencing analysis revealed core sequence variations in the WUS promoters that differentiate low- and high-efficiency genotypes. The present study revealed that cytokinin responses, particularly WUS expression, determine shoot regeneration efficiency in different potato genotypes.
abstract_zh: 植物细胞能够重新编程其命运。生长素和细胞分裂素的组合作用使体细胞去分化以再生器官，这些器官可发育为完整植株。由于转基因植物可通过这些过程从遗传修饰的体细胞中产生，细胞命运转变是作物基因工程中不可避免的一步。然而，再生能力密切依赖于基因型，且这些差异背后的分子事件仍不明确。在本研究中，我们证明了WUSCHEL（WUS）——一种同源域转录因子——决定了不同马铃薯（Solanum tuberosum）基因型的再生能力。对芽再生效率及与细胞命运转变相关基因表达的比较分析显示，WUS表达与不同马铃薯基因型的再生速率一致。此外，在高效率基因型中，WUS沉默抑制了芽再生。同时，在低效率基因型中，通过补充一种促进WUS表达的不同类型细胞分裂素，可增强再生能力。细胞分裂素受体-配体相互作用的计算建模表明，由核心残基氢键介导的细胞分裂素对接姿态可能对马铃薯中WUS表达和芽再生至关重要。此外，我们的全基因组测序分析揭示了WUS启动子中的核心序列变异，这些变异区分了低效率和高效率基因型。本研究揭示，细胞分裂素响应，特别是WUS表达，决定了不同马铃薯基因型的芽再生效率。
